newsitem.title: UK: Approval given to seek rise in UK gas trade fees.
newsitem.headline: Approval given to seek rise in UK gas trade fees.

text.p: Transaction charges for trading gas on the UK spot market may rise from 1.50 stg to 2.75 stg under a plan put forward at a meeting of the Claims Validation Agency, which confirms that gas has actually been delivered after a transaction.

New general manager of Claims Validation Services Ltd, Charles Mason-Smith, said that at a meeting on Monday, approval was given to seek member's agreement to raise the transaction charge by this level.
This applies for each transaction, so that if a company transacts, for example, 25,000 therms a day of gas for a month of 31 days, then the transaction charge is payable 31 times.
Mason-Smith said he could not be sure when the new charge may start to apply.
Otherwise, he said, the meeting renewed director's contracts and discussed "some general bits of business."
